releases.name: RED HALLWAYS: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a strange place made up of endless red hallways. The exit is only a few steps away, but it's locked. To escape, you'll need to search the maze, solve puzzles, and uncover the key before it's too late.

You're not alone.

Something is wandering the hallways, and it's hunting you.

There's just once catch--protecting all those valuables are giant man-eating squids that skip the whole ink-blasting routine and jump straight to the man-eating! If you've got what it takes then grab a blaster and get started!Test your skills and reflexes as  you run and jump across an exotic tropical landscape full of dangerous squid that happen to have an appetite for human! With intuitive controls that are easy to learn, anyone can jump in and immediately get addicted! From collecting coins to use in the store, unlocking awesome new characters and upgrades, and even making the leaderboards with Gamecenter support, Squid Blaster is easily one one of the best free runner games today!Features-Exciting gameplay that puts your gaming skills to the test-Intuitive controls that let you jump and shoot seemlessly!-Collect coins to purchase awesome new upgrades, characters, and more!-Make the leaderboards with Gamecenter support and become the best squid blaster!-Kids Mode provides a fun experience for younger players!

releases.name: Screw IT
releases.summary: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 screws and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of screws. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking screws in a relaxing environment.

releases.summary: Give your best to solve the puzzel and five water to the beast!Can you solve all of them ?!

releases.name: Le Fishe
releases.summary: Le Fishe is a cozy fishing adventure where every cast of your line leads to something new. Catch a wide variety of fish, upgrade your fishing gear, and unlock new locations as you progress. Talk to an interesting cast of characters and try your best to catch the biggest fish of them all!

releases.name: The Midnight 21
releases.summary: The Tortoise and the HareThe hare wants a fair race but the tortoise and his friends keep bullying the hare and interferes with the raceTake the hare safely to the destination by avoiding the stones placed by the tortoise.Sometimes, the tortoise leaves his eggs by mistake.Collect eggs to buy carrots to feed the hare. Buy and wear goggles.Who laughs best who laughs last?How to PlaySimply touch the screen to send the hare up or down.To reach the destination, you must avoid the interference caused by the tortoise and his friends.The ending awaits.When possible, power up the hare with carrots and use them to fly a long distance in a time.

releases.name: Appointment
releases.summary: Appointment is a first-person survival horror game set in a dark, abandoned hospital. Explore, solve interconnected puzzles, search for essential items, and stay quiet as a relentless doctor hunts by sight, sound, and even the light of your flashlight.

The space station has nothing compared to this app and the adventure you are about to experience.Choose from 5 different rockets and get lost in space.  Be sure to collect those oxygen tanks for as you want to make sure you can breath throughout your travels.Experience some of the most challenging terrain in 35 different levels. Good luck!

releases.name: Dojo of a Thousand Lives
releases.summary: It's survival or be eaten by zombies!Help these temple explorers escape from these hungry zombies in this epic adventure!

releases.name: Debt of Life
releases.summary: A narrative survival game about sacrifice and impossible choices. Sell your possessions, manage your resources, and make life-changing decisions as you struggle to survive another week while your fortune and relationships slowly collapse.

releases.name: Paver: Tidy Up Together
releases.summary:
See your favorite games come alive! Get up close and personal with the most exciting game collection for kids and teens!
Dive into mind boggling puzzles or fast and furious action challenges. These games will seem to come alive in your very own hands with engaging graphics and electrifying 3D effects. Now the games you love most offer even more fun and hours upon hours of entertainment!

releases.name: Goddess of Fate: Waifu Strategy RPG
releases.summary: In Goddess of Fate, you will become a Commander and assemble a squad of unique anime heroines. Recruit new allies, strengthen your favorites, discover their stories, and create a team capable of taking on every challenge ahead.
